correctness.rationale: The normalized second divided difference identity is exact; the logarithmic derivative (1/2)(1/r1-1/r4)(1/r2+1/r3) is strictly positive, yielding bijection of onset to the precise (1,R_*) interval. Triangular reconstruction and invertibility of four observable coordinates prove necessary and sufficient conditions. A continuous family of positive-coefficient three-reading fits proves minimality. Symbolic algebra and actual included checker passed 11,203 assertions. Remote-onset expansion was derived from root-sum asymptotics. No finite experiment is treated as a proof.

value.rationale: Unknown data-clock and cumulative-depth gauge origins are physical calibration ambiguities in transient soil tests. The theorem yields both a minimal four-timestamp measurement requirement under arbitrary spacing and an observable exact admissibility test plus unique reconstruction rather than a raw parameter count. The same invariant exposes remote-onset ill conditioning, a useful sampling caveat. It makes no unproved claims about noisy precision, model mismatch or empirical validation.
